title: The Wall Dev Format v1
description: Extension-native export envelope for version 1 of The Wall Dev format. Self-contained: the image is always embedded as an inline PNG data URL, so the file is fully portable with no external hosting required. Supports a single static or animated (sprite-sheet) template layer. Version 1 was not published as a formal schema during active development — this document was reconstructed from the original TypeScript implementation (wall-dev-export.ts).
$comment: Privacy design: the most private export is the default. Author and note are opt-in fields omitted entirely when not requested — a stripped file gives no hint of its creator.

SheetLayout.description: 'line' = all frames in a single row or column. 'grid' = frames arranged in a 2D grid.

GridOrder.description: 'row' = left-to-right, top-to-bottom. 'column' = top-to-bottom, left-to-right. 'serpentine' = alternating direction per row (boustrophedon scan).

ScalingMode.description: 'native' = render at original pixel size, template.scale is forced to 1.0 at export time. 'scaled' = apply template.scale to animation frames.

AnimationBlock.description: WallAnim sprite-sheet animation block. Absent for static templates. Older importers that do not recognise this field load the template as static — backward-compatible by design.

sheet.description: Describes the physical layout of frames within the sprite-sheet image.

frameWidth.description: Width of each individual frame in the sprite sheet (pixels).

frameHeight.description: Height of each individual frame in the sprite sheet (pixels).

frameCount.description: Total number of frames. Importers MUST ignore the animation block and fall back to static rendering when frameCount ≤ 1.

timing.description: Controls playback timing, synchronization anchor, and looping.

startTime.description: Epoch milliseconds (Unix timestamp × 1000) at which the animation timeline begins. All clients synchronize to this absolute timestamp so animations stay in sync across viewers.

defaultFrameMs.description: Default per-frame display duration in milliseconds. Used for every frame not listed in the 'frames' override array.

looping.description: If true, animation restarts from frame 0 after the last frame. If false, playback stops on the last frame.

frames.description: Optional per-frame overrides. Only frames that need custom behaviour need to be listed. Unlisted frames inherit defaultFrameMs and are not skipped.

index.description: Zero-based frame index in traversal order (as defined by sheet.order).

durationMs.description: Custom display duration for this frame in milliseconds. Overrides timing.defaultFrameMs.

skip.description: If true, this frame is excluded from the playback timeline entirely.

scaling.description: Scaling policy for animation frames. When mode is 'native', the exporter forces template.scale to 1.0 at export time.

format.description: Format identifier. Always 'the-wall-dev/1' for this schema version.

version.description: Extension version string at the time of export (e.g. '1.4.2'). Informational only — not used for format routing. Format routing is done exclusively via the 'format' field.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was exported. Generated via new Date().toISOString() at export time.

author.description: Optional author block. Omitted entirely when the user exports anonymously — a file without this field gives no hint of its creator. Partial presence (e.g. username without clan) is valid.
author.$comment: Privacy design: the ENTIRE block is absent for anonymous exports — not present with null values. Importers MUST treat a missing block as fully anonymous.

username.description: The author's username. May be a real handle, an override string, or the literal 'anonymous' — the exporter does not validate the value.

clan_name.description: Display name of the author's primary clan. Omitted when the author declined to share clan info, or when they have no clan.

clan_role.description: The author's role within their clan. Present only when clan_name is also present.

note.description: Free-form plain-text note shown to the importer before the overlay applies. Markdown is intentionally NOT rendered — plain text only to prevent accidental HTML injection from pasted content.

template.description: The single template payload. V1 supports exactly one template per file. V2 introduced the multi-template 'templates' array.

name.description: Optional display name for this template. Absent when the user did not provide one.

image_data_url.description: Inline PNG image as a base64 data URL. Always present — V1 files are fully self-contained and work without any external hosting. Prefer 'data:image/png;base64,...' but any 'data:image/' prefix is accepted.
image_data_url.$comment: At export time the exporter prefers overlayData.srcOrig (lossless original) over overlayData.src (possibly downscaled display copy). Importers MUST NOT fetch external URLs from this field.

x.description: Horizontal position (pixels) of the template's top-left corner on the canvas.

y.description: Vertical position (pixels) of the template's top-left corner on the canvas.

scale.description: Render scale multiplier. 1.0 = native resolution. When animation.scaling.mode is 'native', this field is forced to 1.0 by the exporter regardless of the active overlay scale.

width.description: Width of a single frame in pixels before scaling. At export time this is overlayData.origW (original dimensions) falling back to overlayData.w (display dimensions).

height.description: Height of a single frame in pixels before scaling. At export time this is overlayData.origH (original dimensions) falling back to overlayData.h (display dimensions).
